title: The FV Player 8 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The FV Player 8 plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 8.1.9. This flaw arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of the 'data.videos[].fv_wp_flowplayer_field_splash' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can exploit this vulnerability to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. Additionally, an authorization bypass exists in the wp_ajax_fv_player_db_save handler, allowing subscriber-level attackers to overwrite any existing video record by omitting the data.update field and using an enumerable video ID. The required nonce for this endpoint is publicly accessible to all logged-in users on pages hosting the [fvplayer_editor] shortcode.
